adds.title: The Avengers
adds.text: Selvig warns Fury that the Tesseract is acting up, and moments later Loki comes through it and takes over Selvig's mind in front of him.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: S.H.I.E.L.D. director Selvig warns about the Tesseract before Loki seizes it.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Fury's Tesseract scientist, taken over by Loki in front of him.
adds.evidence: Opening at Project P.E.G.A.S.U.S.: Selvig tells Fury 'The Tesseract is misbehaving'; Loki arrives and enthralls Selvig and Barton while Fury is there.

adds.title: The Avengers
adds.text: Freed from Loki's control after the battle, Selvig hands his friend Thor the Tesseract to take back to Asgard, and Thor touches his shoulder in farewell.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Friend who takes the Tesseract from Selvig back to Asgard.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Friend, freed from Loki's control, who hands Thor the Tesseract.
adds.evidence: Central Park ending: Selvig greets Thor and gives him the Tesseract to take to Asgard; Thor touches his shoulder before leaving.

adds.title: The Avengers
adds.text: J.A.R.V.I.S. runs Tony's suit through the Battle of New York. As Tony carries the nuke toward the portal, J.A.R.V.I.S. asks whether to try calling Pepper.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Carries the nuke toward the portal while J.A.R.V.I.S. tries to reach Pepper.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The A.I. running Tony's suit, who offers to call Pepper as he carries the nuke.
adds.evidence: Battle of New York: J.A.R.V.I.S.: 'Sir, shall I try Miss Potts?' Tony: 'Might as well.' Also J.A.R.V.I.S. runs Tony's decryption of S.H.I.E.L.D.'s files.

adds.title: The Avengers
adds.text: On the Helicarrier, Sitwell tracks Loki down and tells Coulson he is in Stuttgart.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Colleague Sitwell reports Loki's location to.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Colleague who finds Loki in Stuttgart for Coulson.
adds.evidence: Helicarrier: Sitwell: 'We got a hit... Stuttgart, Germany.' in answer to Coulson's 'Location?'

adds.title: The Avengers
adds.text: On the Helicarrier bridge, Hill asks when Tony became an expert in thermonuclear astrophysics, and he says it was the night before.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Stark, who claims he learned the Tesseract science overnight.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Fury's deputy, who doubts Tony's Tesseract know-how.
adds.evidence: Helicarrier bridge: Hill: 'When did you become an expert in thermonuclear astrophysics?' Tony: 'Last night.'

adds.title: The Avengers
adds.text: For Fury's Avengers Initiative, Natasha brings Bruce Banner in from Kolkata, then works under Fury on the Helicarrier in the hunt for Loki.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Natasha's director, whose initiative she recruits Banner for.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Agent who brings Banner in for Fury's initiative.
adds.evidence: Fury reactivates the Avengers Initiative; Romanoff travels to Kolkata to recruit Banner and brings him to the Helicarrier, where Fury thanks Banner for coming.

adds.title: The Avengers
adds.text: Coulson serves Fury through the hunt for Loki until Loki kills him on the Helicarrier. Fury then uses his death to push the Avengers to come together.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Fury's loyal agent, killed by Loki. His death rallies the Avengers.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The director Coulson serves to the end, who uses his death to rally the team.
adds.evidence: Coulson dies telling Fury 'I'm sorry, boss. The god rabbited'; Fury uses Coulson's death (and his trading cards) to motivate the Avengers.

adds.title: The Avengers
adds.text: Coulson brings the Avengers file to Stark Tower, and Pepper greets him warmly by his first name and invites him in.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A S.H.I.E.L.D. friend Pepper welcomes to Stark Tower by name.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's partner, who welcomes Coulson to Stark Tower by name.
adds.evidence: Stark Tower: Coulson arrives with the Avengers Initiative file; Pepper welcomes 'Phil' in, and she and Tony talk with him about the Avengers.

owner_calls.title: The Avengers
owner_calls.question: During the Battle of New York J.A.R.V.I.S. asks Tony 'shall I try Miss Potts?' and places a call Pepper misses. Count that unanswered call as a stage between Pepper and J.A.R.V.I.S. here?
options: Add ally stage: J.A.R.V.I.S. tries to call Pepper as Tony carries the nuke into the portal
owner_calls.evidence: J.A.R.V.I.S. and Tony: 'Sir, shall I try Miss Potts?' 'Might as well.'
